subject: Rstan: R freezes after initialization of second chain

messages.author: 3f22b207863d2049
messages.subject: Rstan: R freezes after initialization of second chain
parts:
Dear Stanfolk,

I'm using rstan to fit a non-linear regression model that considers measurement error in both dependent and independent variables. The model compiles and runs fine, as long as I specify rstan to just produce one chain (the results look entirely plausible, see example fit to data in attached pdf).

However, when I tell rstan to run multiple chains, R always successfully completes the first chain, but then beeps, scrolls to the top of the gui output, and freezes (scrolling still possible, but not typing/copy/pasting). Sometimes some sampling of the second chain seems to occur before R freezes in this way. There are no informative error messages, apart from regular metropolis rejections of initial values of the first, and sometimes, second chain.

I've attached an .r file that generates data, fits the model, and freezes upon initialization of the second chain.

I've retried de-installing rstan, installing inline and rcpp from source, and re-installing rstan, but to no avail. I've also tried rerunning things with subsets of packages loaded, and on one occasion the second chain was successfully simulated when plyr wasn't loaded, although it failed again on repeated attempts (lucky shot?). Below is my session info.

Thanks,

Luc

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Rstan: R freezes after initialization of second chain
parts:
Thanks for reporting with a reproducible example.

I verified I got the same behavior and created an issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/77

I've seen this before and am pretty sure it's related to our use of carriage
return rather than line feed in doing the updates. I don't think it plays
nicely with the GUI. It's why I switched to the terminal.

I hope we can get it fixed by the 2.3 release.

- Bob
